_about: One battle scene per operation. `accent` is the operation's ENCOUNTER accent (flat pixel B color ownership): in battle it drives the header battle count and rule and the enemy card frames and name headers, nothing else (the F9 v3 scene also tints its decal with it). `flat_floor_texture` is the flat tray's floor pattern (a gray mask; its color is the neutral PixelUI.tray_palette, never the encounter). `wall_texture`, `floor_texture`, `edge_accent` and `streak` feed the v3 perspective scene (debug F9). Colours are PixelUI token names, never hexes. Empty fields draw the bare scene. Operations without an entry use `fallback`.

hive.label: Hive (flat floor pattern PLACEHOLDER art; no v3 art)
